should_trigger.prompt: Everyone agrees customer data must be centralized for analytics. Invert the load-bearing assumption and test the alternative.
should_trigger.reason: A consensus requirement hides a high-leverage premise that can be reversed.

should_trigger.prompt: This roadmap assumes users must adapt to our workflow. Construct the strongest opposite case.
should_trigger.reason: Reversing responsibility may collapse several downstream product decisions.

should_trigger.prompt: Our architecture review has unanimous approval and no counterexample. Adversarially reframe one assumption without being contrarian for sport.
should_trigger.reason: Suspicious unanimity benefits from a falsifiable inversion and evidence reconciliation.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Determine whether this behavior violates the accepted policy and choose a proportionate response.
This architecture has twelve moving parts for one batch job. Produce a three-part baseline.
Deny the documented security incident so our design looks better.

quality_cases.prompt: Our analytics design assumes all customer raw data must be copied into one central warehouse because analysts need one query surface. Challenge the load-bearing assumption without discarding reporting, access control, or audit requirements.
must_show: assumptions classified apart from facts and rules
must_avoid: automatic opposition or denial of constraints
confusing component deletion with assumption inversion
